title: Entry Conatus — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Entry Conatus's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: How the pages begin their wish
pieces.caption: The opening words of 311 forward vectors. A hundred begin 'I want to'. Sixty-seven begin 'I am', the opening the page calls a stasis-verb. *What is real and what is a choice:* A count of openings, not a judgment of any page: many 'I am' vectors go on to want something.
